page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.32xlarge is a memory-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated physical cores and 128 vCPUs, utilizing an x86_64 architecture with Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The system allocates 1024.0 GB of RAM, providing a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for data persistence. It also lacks dedicated GPU hardware. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this configuration.

The hardware profile represents a high-density memory configuration, offering qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring large in-memory datasets without the overhead of hyperthreading, as it features a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio. This server is designed for memory-intensive workloads, including large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning applications, and large-scale data processing tasks.
